_meta.purpose: Ground truth for scripts/score_agent.py. For each item, fill in answer.outcome as either "identified" (and set answer.canonical_ins + answer.classification to the correct values) or "correctly_declined" (the label genuinely does not determine an identity -- leave canonical_ins/classification null). Leaving outcome null means the item has not been reviewed yet and score_agent.py should skip it, not score it as a miss.
_meta.excluded_reason: scratch/test data from LangGraph pipeline development, not a curated label
_meta.method: Each answer was decided by reading the item name and its source label. Ordinary foods are 'identified' with a null canonical_ins, since food ingredients have no INS number. Items where the label genuinely does not determine which additive is meant are 'correctly_declined'.
